episodes.title: The Rajneesh Cult Poisoned A Town's SALAD BARS To Steal An Election
episodes.description:
Ma Anand Sheela ran the Rajneesh cult with fake AIDS tests, heavy sedatives, and a medical clinic she used as a weapon. If you crossed her, you didn't leave. If you tried to warn anyone, she was already reading your mail.

But her most audacious move was still to come: a homemade bioweapons lab, salmonella cultured in secret, and a plan to poison an entire town's salad bars; all before a crucial Election Day.

episodes.title: 7,000 People Built A Secret City in Oregon for Their Cult Leader
episodes.description:
In 1981, a spiritual leader known as the "sex guru" bought 64,000 acres of abandoned ranch land in rural Oregon and moved thousands of followers there. Within two years, they'd built an entire city called Rajneeshpuram from scratch.

And when the locals tried to dissolve their own town to stop them… it didn't work.
